```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(thematic)
# Install thematic and un-comment for themed static plots (i.e., ggplot2)
# thematic::thematic_rmd()

library(here)
library(caret)
library(readxl)
library(ggfortify)
library(GGally)
library(glmnet)
library(plotly)

library(tidyverse)


db <- read_excel(here("data/dataform.xlsx"))
db <- na.omit(db)

db$ID <- as.factor(db$ID) 
db$Group <- as.factor(db$Group) 
long_db <- db %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(ID, Group), names_to = "Predictor", values_to = "Value")
```

## Column {.tabset data-width="650"}
---------------------------------------------------------------------

### Chart A

```{r}

p <- long_db %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Group, y = Value, fill = Group)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~ Predictor, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#6996e3", "#dd5129", "#2b9b81")) +
  theme_classic()

ggplotly(p)

```
